candidates.change_summary: Return the ERC20 transfer selector (0xa9059cbb) instead of the correct onERC721Received selector.
Return bytes4(0) instead of the correct onERC721Received selector.
Delete the statement `baseToken = _baseToken;` so `baseToken` remains address(0) after initialization.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;` so baseToken is set to the NFT address instead.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = address(0);` so baseToken is always the zero address after initialization.
Delete the statement `nft = _nft;` so the `nft` state variable remains its default address(0) after initialization.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = _baseToken;` so the nft state variable is set to the base token address instead.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = address(0);` so the nft state variable is always reset to the zero address after initialization.
